messages.subject: lavaan version 0.6.17.1884
parts:
Hi,
According to the webpage "https://lavaan.ugent.be/#news", lavaan version is: 0.6-16.
However, in the 'efa' example shown in the webpage "https://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/efa.html#exploratory-factor-analysis-efa" (please check the output meesage below the gray box containing lavaan code) it appears that the lavaan version is 0.6.17.1884.
Why this new version?
Many thanks,
Henrique

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: lavaan version 0.6.17.1884
parts:
When I built the last version of the lavaan website, 0.6.17.1884 was
simply the lavaan version that was installed on my machine. It is the
development version, and will eventually become 0.6-17.

But I understand this may be confusing. I will see if I can modify my
script to always use the current CRAN version.

Yves.
